value: Starter $19.00/mo, default Monthly display state, entry paid tier. FAQ ties video output directly to posting frequency ("the number of videos created by each series can be seen on our pricing page"); Starter's published rate is 3 posts/week (JSON frequency:3). Videos/mo = 3 x (30/7 days-per-week, per the codebook's own day-conversion convention) = 12.857. $19.00 / 12.857 = $1.48 per video. Not used as the basis: Motion Credits (27/mo; tooltip: a fully-animated video "typically" costs 15-20 credits "if motion is applied to all scenes") -- credits meter motion applied to an image, not a video, are optional (Free tier: 1 video, 0 credits), and computing from them requires assuming full-motion use on every scene of every video, which rule 7 excludes. That alternate path, if taken anyway, gives a range of $19.00/1.35=$14.07 to $19.00/1.80=$10.56 per fully-animated video (27/20=1.35 to 27/15=1.8 videos/mo) -- recorded here for transparency, not the coded basis.
